name: Camping 101: Fishing

angles.text: A proper campsite needs a campfire. Basic cooking training pairs naturally with a fisherman's camp in the wild.
As a Horde angler traveling through Mulgore, you can learn to make camp fixtures from Uthan Stillwater in Bloodhoof Village.

faq.answer: A Fish Bowl is a camp fixture made by skilled fishermen. It brings comfort and cheer to travelers resting in the wilderness, lifting their spirits and helping them stay sharp in battle.
faq.q: What does the Fish Bowl do for a campsite?

faq.answer: Uthan Stillwater teaches the craft in Bloodhoof Village, in Mulgore. He teaches anglers who have already shown skill at fishing.
faq.q: Who teaches the Fish Bowl recipe?

aliases: why cant i camp in bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Settlements like Bloodhoof Village do not allow travelers to set up camps in town. Pitch your camp in the open wild instead.
faq.q: Why can't you pitch camp inside a settlement?

faq.answer: A proper campsite needs a campfire. If you do not know how to kindle one, seek out a cooking trainer to learn basic fire-making.
faq.q: What else is required to set up a camp?

aliases: when can i get fish bowl
faq.answer: You need to show fishing skill before Uthan Stillwater will teach you to make camp fixtures. If you are a novice angler, spend time honing your craft by the water first.
faq.q: What requirements are needed before learning the Fish Bowl?

faq.answer: A Fish Bowl brings a touch of home to a hard, tiring life on the road. Watching a fish by the fire can bring joy and lift an adventurer's spirits.
faq.q: Why would an adventurer want a Fish Bowl while camping?

sections.body: Anglers passing through Mulgore can put their quiet pastime to use around camp. If you have proved your skill with rod and reel, seek out Uthan Stillwater in Bloodhoof Village. He teaches skilled fishermen to make a Fish Bowl, a homely touch for a campsite.
sections.title: Angling in the Wild

sections.body: A Fish Bowl brings a little cheer to a hard journey. Its calm presence makes a resting place in the wild more pleasant and lifts the spirits of those gathered there. Better spirits mean sharper instincts and greater resilience in battle.
sections.title: Comforts of Camp

sections.body: A campsite belongs in the open country, not in a settlement like Bloodhoof Village. The Fish Bowl can only be tried in the wilderness. A camp also needs a proper fire, so seek out a culinary trainer to learn basic fire-making before you set one up.
sections.title: Campfire and Open Country

summary: In Mulgore, anglers can turn fishing into a comfort for camps in the wild. Show Uthan Stillwater in Bloodhoof Village your skill with rod and reel, and he teaches you to make a Fish Bowl for travelers resting outdoors.
